item.title: Valkyrie Runabout!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rosebleu
  • 発売日: 2015-03-27
  • スコア: 7.209999999999999/10 (51 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 戦乙女らんなばうとっ！
  • 英語名: Valkyrie Runabout!

别名

  • Walkure Runabout!

あらすじ

Three years ago, Yuuki was summoned to another world, Dinia, which was being attacked by the forces of the demon lord. Even though he was merely a normal student, he gained great powers and they soon called him the ‘great wise man’. After helping the hero Scana take down the demon lord, he was been unable to return to his own world. They had fallen in love during the difficult journey and promised to marry each other, but they were separated due to the underhanded scheme of some corrupt nobles. For his great achievement, he was ultimately rewarded with only disappointment and despair.

item.title: Sekai o Sukuu Dake no Kantan na Oshigoto
item.description:

  • ブランド: Rosebleu
  • 発売日: 2014-09-26
  • スコア: 7.35/10 (85 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 世界を救うだけの簡単なお仕事
  • 英語名: Sekai o Sukuu Dake no Kantan na Oshigoto

别名

  • Sekasuku

あらすじ

Arata is a hot-blooded guy who aims to become a hero and runs about every day helping others along with his osananajimi Akari. One day, he received a mail looking for heroes to save the world. He thought it was just spam, but it was actually a genuine contract mail. His room became a gate to another world Ragnagia and an epic adventure full of laughs and tears awaited them… or so he thought.

item.title: Inpyuri -Hito to Anata to Ayakashi to-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rosebleu
  • 発売日: 2013-02-28
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (45 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いんぴゅり -ヒトとアナタとアヤカシと-
  • 英語名: Inpyuri -Hito to Anata to Ayakashi to-

别名

  • tototo

あらすじ

Strange other-worldly beings known as youkai have existed in Japan since ancient times. Not too far in the future, humans lived together with youkai harmoniously and studied their mysterious abilities. Kazuto lived in the research city of Byakuya-jima and had grown up with youkai by his side. Following his motto of enjoying every moment of life, he enrolled in Shiramine Gakuen with his osananajimi Shizune. However, on the day of the entrance ceremony, he reunited with a girl who he used to play with and who had saved his life: the oni girl Miyabi. That spelled the end of his normal days as many other youkai and humans flocked to his side.

  • 英語名: Hyouka no Mau Sora ni

别名

  • hyoka

あらすじ

Suou lived in a small town blanketed by snow every winter. One day, his cousin Shiina moved in with him after her parents went overseas. Her transfer into the school so close to the winter vacation was the talk of the school. It had been a long time since he had seen her and their time together is quite different from back then. Then a rumour spread that the school might be closed down…
